[SONAR SYS-1 (1).pptx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32061043/SONAR.SYS-1.1.pptx)
The full waveform is precomputed once and stored in memory, then streamed to the DAC via hardware timer + DMA zero CPU involvement per sample, letting the processor sleep between pulses for maximum efficiency. For unexpected conditions outside known presets, the CPU briefly wakes to compute a new waveform on the fly, using double buffering so DMA keeps streaming without interruption- keeping the system power efficient by default, yet still adaptive to genuinely novel scenarios
